name: Bash
description: Run a shell command in the project and return its combined output. The working directory persists between calls while it stays inside the project. Timeout is in milliseconds (default 120000, max 600000).

description.description: A few words on what the command does

run_in_background.description: Run the command in the background

name: Edit
description: Replace an exact string in a file. old_string must occur exactly once unless replace_all is true.

name: Read
description: Read a text file. Lines are returned as '<number>\t<text>'. Reads up to 2000 lines unless offset and limit are given. Large files return a first page; allow_large reads the whole file.

allow_large.description: Read a file over the usual size limits

name: Write
description: Write a file, replacing any existing content.
